purpose: Fitting-only compatibility check of complementary estimators after denser matching produced sparse seeds; no new inference and no acceptance-threshold change
edge_policy: for each camera pair use the first already-passing source in the declared priority; never choose an edge by the sign/value of its lag or by cycle residual
gate: all cameras connected, no unvalidated bridge, signed fundamental-cycle closure and fitted edge residual <=0.25 frame; reference-relative offsets strictly within +/-25 frames
no_pruning: Do not remove inconsistent edges or refit the calibration to make this diagnostic pass
status_meaning: A pass is only fitting eligibility and still needs frozen reserved timing selection/final checks. A failure is evidence that the available individually precise constraints do not form a consistent rig-wide solution.
